events.text: A hut on a cliff, smoke from the chimney, and nobody home. A pot of tea is still warm.

effects.log: At dusk, an old hermit returns and shares the tea. He speaks three sentences, all of them wise.

choices.text: Leave a coin for the tea you drank

effects.log: Honest. Somewhere, a hermit smiles.

events.text: Behind a waterfall, a cave with old handprints on the wall, hundreds of them, pressed into stone.

effects.log: Your hand fits one exactly. A warmth goes up your arm.
The handprints are a palm form. You learn it slowly.

events.text: An old battlefield where nothing grows. Rusted weapons stick out of the earth like reeds.

effects.log: A day of digging. The wind feels gentler at dusk.
Most are rust. One is not. You clean it for a week.

events.text: A hot spring in the snow, steaming under the stars.

effects.log: Old aches melt away.
Warm water, cold air, a very clear mind.

events.text: A bamboo forest so dense that the light turns green. The wind makes it sing.

effects.log: The rhythm of the bamboo becomes the rhythm of your breath.
A perfect bamboo staff. Light, strong, yours.

events.text: An abandoned village. The doors are open, the pots still on the stoves, and there is no sign of what happened.

ok.log: A plague, forty years ago. You find a diary. You bury it with honour.

fail.log: You find nothing. The silence follows you for days.

effects.log: Some places want to be left alone.

variants: An empty village. Doors hang open, pots sit on cold stoves, and nothing says where everyone went.

events.text: On a cliff ledge, an eagle's nest holds something glittering.

ok.log: A jade ring, dropped by some unlucky traveller. (+20 taels)

fail.log: The eagle returns. You retreat with scratches.

effects.log: Every creature is allowed one shiny thing.

events.text: A lake so still it reflects the moon perfectly. It feels like two moons, and you between them.

effects.log: The two moons become one light.
Seven skips. The moon wobbles, then forgives you.

variants: A lake so still the moon sits in it whole. Two moons, and you standing between them.

events.text: An ancient road marker points to a town that does not exist on any map.

ok.log: A tiny village untouched by time. They feed you and ask for news of the emperor from a hundred years ago.

fail.log: The road ends in a swamp.

effects.log: Mysteries are best kept.

events.text: A small shrine at a mountain pass, with fresh offerings but no keeper.

effects.log: Some unseen keeper will be pleased.
Clean stone, clear mind.

events.text: A clearing where ginseng grows like weeds. Too good to be true.

ok.log: Real ginseng. A small fortune. (+40 taels)

fail.log: It is a plant that looks like ginseng and tastes like regret.

effects.log: Greed is a poison too.

events.text: A waterfall frozen solid in the winter, a pillar of blue ice.

effects.log: Ice axes, bleeding hands, a view from the top.
The ice teaches precision.

events.text: A boat sunk in the shallows, half-buried in sand. The name is still readable: a merchant ship lost ten years ago.

effects.log: The family of the captain gives you a reward. (+15 taels)
Mostly mud. One sealed jar of very old pickled plums.

events.text: A monk has been meditating in a cave for three years. He opens one eye as you enter.

effects.log: A day of silence. You leave lighter.
He nods. That is all. It is enough.

events.text: A forest of stone pillars, each one shaped like a warrior mid-strike.

effects.log: Some are natural. Some are not. You learn from both.
From the top, the forest looks like an army frozen in time.

events.text: Glowing moss on a cave wall. Local legend says it heals any wound.

effects.log: It does help, a little.
Legends are better left intact.

events.text: A herd of white deer crosses your path at dawn. The old people say they only appear to the pure of heart.

effects.log: They pass within arm's reach.
They lead you to a spring of clear water, then vanish.

events.text: An old watchtower crumbling on a hill. From the top, you can see three provinces.

effects.log: Three provinces, one sunset.
An old soldier's helmet, and a letter never sent.

events.text: Fishermen say a river spirit takes one boat a year. This year, it is your ferry's turn, apparently.

choices.text: Make an offering to the spirit

effects.log: The crossing is calm. Probably coincidence.
A storm comes up mid-river. You make it, barely.

events.text: A shooting star falls into the hills. You find a still-warm stone of black iron.

effects.log: A smith would pay well for sky-iron. (+30 taels)

choices.text: Take it to a smith for a blade

effects.log: The blade hums faintly.
